policy: Optional observed wildlife; no quest gates, rewards, testimony or replayable supplies. Bodies are constructed before destination readiness.

sightings.name: Reed Choir
sightings.title: The bank sings before the bell
sightings.observation: Small throats pulse among the wet reeds. The calls stop when Kael steps close, then answer one another beneath the bridge. These are living creatures, not voices from the binding.
sightings.connection: Anwen keeps the bank clear because a silent reed bed often means fouled water. The village's warning bell belongs to people; this smaller warning belongs to the river.

sightings.name: Glassmoth
sightings.title: Light caught in old resin
sightings.observation: A translucent wing catches the light above a split trunk. The moth works at hardened resin, turning away when a shadow crosses its perch.
sightings.connection: Mira gathers only fallen resin. Leaving the living cut alone gives the moth food and the tree time to seal itself.

sightings.name: Gallows Weaver
sightings.title: A web that remembers no crime
sightings.observation: Silk joins the abandoned frame to a root. The long-legged weaver tightens one strand, then waits. Its work follows weight and vibration, not guilt.
sightings.connection: Tor marks the empty frame before dismantling it. The timber can be reused without pretending the thing built from it never existed.

sightings.name: Silt Maw
sightings.title: What settled under the mill
sightings.observation: A low body noses through wet silt beneath the bank. Small stones roll out beside its mouth; fibers and grit remain around the burrow.
sightings.connection: The millwrights read these heaps before opening the sluice. A blocked channel is a working problem first, not proof of another curse.

sightings.name: Millback
sightings.title: A shell beneath the wheel
sightings.observation: A broad plated scavenger tests the mud with its forelimbs. Its shell carries rubbed bands where debris has passed over it.
sightings.connection: Nessa's supply workers keep their drying racks away from its feeding edge. Work can resume without turning every inhabitant of the mill into an enemy.

sightings.name: Shroud Swimmer
sightings.title: A shape in the flooded reeds
sightings.observation: A thin body folds in the shallow pool, its pale edges moving with the water. Caught cloth is only cloth; this animal offers no account of who once wore it.
sightings.connection: Nera checks the snag from the causeway. Relief cargo belongs on a secure crossing, not in the same loose loops that catch the swimmer.

sightings.name: Hearthscale
sightings.title: Warmth without a house
sightings.observation: A plated creature lies against sun-warmed masonry. Its flank rises slowly. It opens one eye at Kael, then settles rather than pursuing him.
sightings.connection: Elna leaves this part of the ruined hearth undisturbed. A new home need not begin by clearing away every life that survived the old one. Bracken belongs to this same species.

sightings.name: Inkblind
sightings.title: The archive's uninvited reader
sightings.observation: A small dark animal follows paste along a discarded binding strip. It cannot read a name. Its damaged scraps are not a substitute for the intact command record.
sightings.connection: Vale stores the original pages above the floor and keeps a tray for waste paste. Preserving evidence requires ordinary care as well as courage.

sightings.name: Knell Leech
sightings.title: Movement under the ringing stone
sightings.observation: A soft body contracts against damp stone. It recoils from a footfall, then extends along the same wet seam. The response follows vibration, not spoken promises.
sightings.connection: The bell reaches places its keepers never enter. This trace explains a creature's behavior, not the origin of Halvern's bound account.

sightings.name: Cairn Mother
sightings.title: Life beside the boundary stones
sightings.observation: A heavy, lichen-marked body rests beside the old stones, turning its head toward disturbed ground. It carries no human memory and makes no covenant.
sightings.connection: Mira leaves a gap between the new planting and its shelter. The White Hart remains the witness; this creature is one of the lives that must continue after the choice.
